The curl+tar+gzip toolchain the mise builder stage needs (the stage
downloads the pinned mise release). Composed into the per-distro
builder boxes; the package names resolve per the image's distro.

## Packages

Installed on every distro:

- `curl`
- `tar`
- `gzip`
